question: Derive and test the shared-face Wilson readout and compact descent of the skew Hodge–Dirac flow
assumptions: Oriented filled bipyramid, unit simplex metric and real linear generator
Compact edge readout and its scale are declared
target_exposure: Known pinned -i compact witness. No empirical fit.
baseline: Real paired-sector flow versus descent to compact edge quotient
result: Shared-face signal is harmonic at sqrt(5); no nonzero DC or native phase selection. Declared compact Wilson readout gives -i at selected times. Real skew flow fails descent to the edge-only compact quotient.
next_discriminant: Construct and test an autonomous compact transport law or specify a real-lift readout and an independently derived normalization.
